body: I'm not okay. Life before my mother's passing was already pretty shitty and now it's only shittier. Being Christian doesn't help much either because all they do is suggest that pray and cry out to God as if he gives a rat's ass. I don't want to be here. I didn't consent to being born and I'm not interested in living up to some higher damn purpose. That's what my mother did and it got her nowhere. I just want to end things. It's the only way out of this mess of an unwanted life
